idea-plugin.name: Changelog Fragment Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Manages per-PR changelog fragments, the towncrier-style convention: instead of every PR editing the same CHANGELOG.md and fighting merge conflicts, each PR adds a small changelog.d/<issue>.<type>.md file, later collected into a real changelog at release time.

New Changelog Fragment (Tools menu) prompts for an issue/PR number, a type, and a one-line description, and writes the file for you -- no need to remember the naming convention by hand. An inspection flags any file inside changelog.d/ whose name doesn't match the convention (typo'd type, missing issue number, wrong extension) before it ships in a release.

100% local file convention, no towncrier/external tool required. Stated honestly: v0.1 hardcodes the common default type set (feature/bugfix/doc/removal/misc) and only checks a directory literally named changelog.d -- a custom type list or a differently-named fragments directory isn't covered yet.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Changelog fragment file name doesn't match the convention

action.description: Create a new changelog.d/<issue>.<type>.md fragment file
